This is a single-complex page for a TOWNHOME community, not an apartment-condo page: Fox & Aikins North is at 1871 165A Street in Grandview Heights, South Surrey, and its sister phase Fox & Aikins South is a different phase at a different address, 1833 165A Street — North and South must never be merged.

items.t: Board geography: the containing board sub-area is Grandview. There is no Fox & Aikins board sub-area and no per-complex board figure: any complex-only count, median or ratio is not verified.

Transit: no TransLink timetable document for a route serving 165A Street at this address was opened pass, so route and frequency claims for this complex are not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Fox & Aikins North Townhomes

items.t: Surrey secondary suites and SSMUH (context for Grandview lots, not this strata complex): the City defines a secondary suite as an accessory dwelling unit whose habitable floor area does not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit, within a single family, semi-detached or duplex building, and not a separate strata lot, with only one suite permitted per dwelling unit; the City adopted its SSMUH zoning changes on July 8, 2024 — a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop.

The page has no feed to watch.
Sources disagree on the build year by one year. The strata's own documents, not either web line, settle the completion date for warranty purposes.
The elementary school is on the complex's own street.
Grandview's attached pool is the community's second-largest.

faq.a: No. North is 1871 165A Street and South is 1833 165A Street; the developer brochure for South describes that phase as 43 townhomes by Park Ridge Homes, while North is documented at 42 townhomes. A South sale is a neighbouring-phase comparable, not a sale in North.
faq.q: Are Fox & Aikins North and South the same complex?

faq.a: Do not price a North unit from the South Surrey White Rock community Condos & Townhomes median of $700,000 — it covers every attached product in the community.

faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022, so the strata cannot enforce one; short-term rentals can still be restricted.
